name: RLS Additive Grants Example
description: Additive row-level security: a user's scope is the UNION of every team grant and personal grant they hold. CurrentUserInTeam() is resolved per grant ROW (never against a concatenated team-name string - it silently fails for multi-team entities) and aggregated with Max(); CurrentUserEmail() covers personal grants. A compound-key Lookup() matches (entity_type, entity_value) against one grants ledger - no per-dimension child tables, no user attributes, no team-to-user mapping replicated into the warehouse.

elements.name: Entity Grants
elements.description: The grants ledger. Additive by construction: no priority column.

columns.name: Team Principal
columns.description: Diagnostic only: null for user grants, so ListAgg yields teams.

columns.name: User Principal
columns.description: Diagnostic only: null for team grants, so ListAgg yields emails.

columns.formula: If([Principal Type] = "team", Coalesce(CurrentUserInTeam([Principal ID]), False), [Principal ID] = CurrentUserEmail())
columns.name: Grant Applies
columns.description: Does THIS grant row apply to the current user?

columns.name: Grant Applies Num
columns.description: Numeric form so Max() can aggregate it additively: Max = 1 means at least one grant matched.

elements.name: Shipments
elements.description: Fact table secured by the additive grants pattern.

columns.name: Office Team Names
columns.formula: Lookup(ListAgg([Entity Grants/Team Principal], ","), [Office Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Office], [Entity Grants/Entity Value])

columns.name: Office User Emails
columns.formula: Lookup(ListAgg([Entity Grants/User Principal], ","), [Office Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Office], [Entity Grants/Entity Value])

columns.name: Office RLS
columns.formula: Coalesce(Lookup(Max([Entity Grants/Grant Applies Num]), [Office Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Office], [Entity Grants/Entity Value]), 0) = 1

columns.name: Company Team Names
columns.formula: Lookup(ListAgg([Entity Grants/Team Principal], ","), [Company Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Company], [Entity Grants/Entity Value])

columns.name: Company User Emails
columns.formula: Lookup(ListAgg([Entity Grants/User Principal], ","), [Company Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Company], [Entity Grants/Entity Value])

columns.name: Company RLS
columns.formula: Coalesce(Lookup(Max([Entity Grants/Grant Applies Num]), [Company Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Company], [Entity Grants/Entity Value]), 0) = 1

columns.name: Site Team Names
columns.formula: Lookup(ListAgg([Entity Grants/Team Principal], ","), [Site Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Site], [Entity Grants/Entity Value])

columns.name: Site User Emails
columns.formula: Lookup(ListAgg([Entity Grants/User Principal], ","), [Site Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Site], [Entity Grants/Entity Value])

columns.name: Site RLS
columns.formula: Coalesce(Lookup(Max([Entity Grants/Grant Applies Num]), [Site Key], [Entity Grants/Entity Type], [Site], [Entity Grants/Entity Value]), 0) = 1

columns.name: Combined RLS
columns.description: Visible if ANY dimension grants this row — the additive union.

columns.name: Combined RLS Num
columns.description: Filter target: 1 = visible to the current user.
